title: Back up the garbage truck: A look at how AI will impact margins in AI
description: I'm increasingly conviced that the trade in AI is no longer the model makers or the vendors, but at the user level. This is the RAMP trade that I've been writing about since last year (real assets, margin potential). Today we get some insight into how it will unfold and the potential. At this point, you don't need to build the best AI model to make money from artificial intelligence. You might just need a fleet of garbage trucks and a better way to route them. title: Some anniversaries aren’t meant to be celebrated. They are simply remembered and never forgotten.
description: Today is an anniversary. Anniversaries are often days of celebration. They are also days of remembrance. Today is not a day to celebrate. It is a day to pause and remember—to remember all those who “slipped the surly bonds of Earth” and touched the face of God. I personally knew three people who died that day. Ironically, each was named John, and each was working on the upper floors of the World Trade Center. It is difficult to imagine what they went through.
